profile.name: Jyotirmoy Chakraborty

profile.headline: Engineering intelligent, reliable and safe energy systems.

projects.title: Safety-Gated Edge–Cloud Battery Digital Twin
projects.subtitle: Condition-aware cloud assistance without giving up local safety.
projects.status: Simulation and PIL-oriented work; CHIL planned
projects.source: Scientific project report, October 2026; academic CV
projects.problem: Continuous cloud communication is expensive and introduces latency. A battery manager still needs local estimation and protection when connectivity becomes unreliable.
projects.role: Developed the four-cell modelling approach, event-trigger logic, safety gate, estimator structure and embedded-oriented validation workflow.
projects.method: A four-cell equivalent-circuit and thermal plant feeds an edge BMS. Residuals, uncertainty and safety margins determine when the controller requests cloud help. Returned corrections are checked for physical consistency, confidence and freshness before use.
projects.outcome: Approximately 82.8% fewer edge-to-cloud communications relative to continuous communication in the tested PIL configuration.
projects.limitation: Physical Controller Hardware-in-the-Loop results have not yet been reported. Stability guarantees and cross-chemistry generalization remain open research directions.
projects.future: Perform OPAL-RT / physical TI C2000 closed-loop validation; quantify latency and overruns; investigate formal event-triggering and robust estimation guarantees.
projects.source_note: October 2026 project report, sections 1–16. Code repository is private and is not linked.
projects.kpi_caption: less cloud communication · tested PIL configuration

projects.title: Battery ML Monitoring Platform
projects.subtitle: Observability for battery-health models after deployment.
projects.problem: Battery ML models can become less reliable after deployment as chemistry, temperature and degradation conditions change.
projects.role: Built a battery-oriented monitoring workflow with dataset handling, multi-model inference, drift and performance checks, alerting and export hooks.
projects.method: Dataset registry → preprocessing and model inference → drift / performance monitoring → alerts, reporting and potential retraining workflows.
projects.outcome: Repository documents an implemented monitoring stack with battery-focused demos and CLI tools; no independent field-performance metric is claimed here.
projects.limitation: Production fleet deployment and independently verified reliability statistics are not established by the available repository documentation.
projects.future: Validate on longer multi-chemistry ageing datasets and connect monitoring outputs to real edge deployments.

projects.title: BatteryWise · Local Battery Analytics
projects.subtitle: Practical, privacy-conscious health insights from laptop telemetry.
projects.problem: Battery percentage alone does not explain stress, charging patterns or longer-term behaviour.
projects.role: Built telemetry collection, event logging, local analytics and CSV exports. Developed a local-first desktop workflow.
projects.method: Laptop battery measurements → local FastAPI backend → SQLite storage → battery analytics and desktop dashboard → raw/daily CSV export.
projects.outcome: Windows local application and test/demo path are documented. CSV export supports later health and degradation analysis.
projects.limitation: The repository describes a Flutter client as a scaffold, not a completed production mobile app.
projects.future: Evaluate ageing indicators with longitudinal telemetry and extend the validated desktop experience.
projects.source_note: Academic CV (2026); public BatteryWise README (29 August 2026).

projects.title: Data-Driven Battery SOC Estimation
projects.subtitle: Comparing neural-network approaches to state-of-charge prediction.
projects.problem: SOC cannot be directly measured and must be inferred from available battery signals.
projects.role: Developed a modelling and evaluation workflow to compare FCN, CNN and LSTM approaches, including data processing and hyperparameter optimization.
projects.method: LG HG2 battery measurements → time-series preprocessing → neural models → Optuna tuning → MSE/MAE evaluation and prediction plots.
projects.outcome: Reproducible workflow and code documented in the repository; this website does not state a single best score without a validated summary.
projects.limitation: Generalization across chemistry, temperature and hardware deployment is not demonstrated by the README alone.
projects.future: Explore physical constraints and uncertainty estimates for transfer across operating conditions.
projects.source_note: Public GitHub README; data credited to Kollmeyer et al., Mendeley Data (2020).

projects.title: NEXUS P2P Workspace
projects.subtitle: A local-first approach to device discovery and encrypted collaboration.
projects.problem: Device-to-device collaboration can be cumbersome when it depends on manual setup or a central service.
projects.role: Engineered local peer discovery, encrypted messaging and clipboard synchronization, and reactive UI state synchronization.
projects.method: UDP discovery and subnet scanning → encrypted communication using secp256k1 and AES-256-GCM → Server-Sent Events and Node.js streams for UI updates and transfers.
projects.outcome: Implemented a local-first workspace described in the CV; no benchmarked throughput figure is given.
projects.limitation: A public repository matching this exact 2024 P2P project was not conclusively verified; no code link is provided.
projects.future: Document interoperability, threat modelling and large-file transfer performance.

projects.title: Real-Time Social Distance Monitoring
projects.subtitle: Computer vision and geometry for real-world distance assessment.
projects.problem: Monitoring spacing in crowded scenes requires identifying people and correcting perspective distortion.
projects.role: Built person detection, perspective calibration and a custom 3D-printed camera mounting setup.
projects.method: YOLOv5 detections → perspective transform → physical-distance estimation → visual risk indication.
projects.outcome: CV reports 89% detection accuracy in crowded indoor environments and 60% lower hardware cost from a custom mount; experimental protocols are not available in the supplied files.
projects.limitation: Accuracy and cost figures are CV-reported rather than independently reproduced in this portfolio.
projects.future: Evaluate domain shift, camera calibration robustness and privacy-preserving inference.

projects.title: Battery Health Intelligence Dashboard
projects.subtitle: From sensor streams to understandable risk and model-health reports.
projects.problem: Battery telemetry needs interpretable anomaly detection and clear data-quality reporting.
projects.role: Created the monitoring dashboard and API workflow described in the repository, with time-series anomaly scoring and model-health reporting.
projects.method: CSV readings → FastAPI API → rolling-baseline anomaly checks → SQLite storage → React dashboard and drift summaries.
projects.outcome: Code and demo dataset are provided; no live fleet deployment or measured reliability benefit is claimed.
projects.limitation: The sample data should not be confused with independent experimental validation.
projects.future: Validate anomaly precision and false alarm rates on real sensor faults.

projects.title: Edge-Preserving Image Denoising
projects.subtitle: Deep learning informed by multiscale image representations.
projects.source: LinkedIn project description; public repository README
projects.problem: Reducing image noise without blurring important edges is difficult for conventional smoothing methods.
projects.role: Implemented a workflow combining multiscale shearlet decomposition with CNN-based classification of edge versus noise patches.
projects.method: NSST decomposition → patch feature extraction → CNN classification → selective thresholding → image reconstruction.
projects.outcome: Repository provides an implementation and example evaluation material; this work reproduces ideas from published literature and is not claimed as a new publication.
projects.limitation: Published method authorship belongs to the original research paper; repo-level results should be independently reproduced before comparison claims.
projects.future: Evaluate robustness to varied noise distributions and real imagery.
projects.source_note: LinkedIn project listing (Sep–Dec 2024); repository credits Shahdoosti & Rahemi (2019).
